gloss: riding double; riding two on one vehicle

definitions.gloss: riding two people on one vehicle; riding double
definitions.explanation: Two people riding together on a vehicle meant primarily for one, such as a bicycle or motorcycle. Compound of {二人|ふたり} (two people) + {乗|の}り (riding).

examples.japanese: ⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{二人乗|ふたりの}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危|あぶ}ない→危ない：00768_abunai⟧。
examples.english: Riding double on a bicycle is dangerous.

examples.japanese: ⟦バイク→バイク：05081_baiku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{二人乗|ふたりの}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: We went out riding double on the motorcycle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{原付|げんつき}→原付：26791_gentsuki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{二人乗|ふたりの}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Riding double on a moped is prohibited by law.

notes:
Carrying a passenger on a vehicle designed mainly for one rider. Often appears in safety and traffic-rule contexts, since ⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧ (bicycle) double-riding and ⟦{原付|げんつき}→原付：26791_gentsuki⟧ (50cc moped) double-riding are illegal in Japan.

USAGE:
- {二人乗|ふたりの}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧・{二人乗|ふたりの}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to ride double
- The pattern extends to other numbers: {三人乗|さんにんの}り (carrying three).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{相乗|あいの}り→相乗り：26000_ainori⟧: sharing a ride — two or more people sharing one taxi or car, splitting it
